description: Prof.Maithree Wickramesinghe Being Summoned by FCID: Authorities Urged to Ensure that  Due Process is  Followed  and that  Investigators must avoid unwarranted harassment, intimidation or reputational harm to independent academics. “Academic freedom, institutional autonomy, and the protection of scholars from political victimisation are essential pillars of a democratic society,” says statement signed by 85 Persons
